findings.description: Rust lib crate using define_component! and define_interface! macros from component-framework
findings.notes: Both macros used correctly to define SPDKEnvComponent and ISPDKEnv

findings.description: ISPDKEnv interface with init(), devices(), device_count(), is_initialized()
findings.notes: All specified methods present plus fini() (unspecced addition)

findings.description: SPDK/DPDK environments initialized in init(), not during construction
findings.notes: Constructor sets empty state; init() performs all initialization

findings.description: Verifies /dev/vfio and vfio-pci kernel module before initialization
Checks R/W permissions on /dev/vfio, /dev/vfio/vfio, and IOMMU group files with specific error messages
findings.notes: Reports specific path, uid, gid, mode, and remediation hints (udev rules, group membership)

findings.description: Enumerates NVMe devices via spdk_pci_enumerate with NVMe PCI driver; provides BDF, vendor/device IDs, class ID, NUMA node, device type; callback returns non-zero to avoid attaching
findings.notes: Callback returns 1 (non-zero) preserving devices for later spdk_nvme_probe

findings.description: System uses eprintln! for diagnostics; no logger receptacle; component has no receptacles
findings.notes: eprintln! usage and absence of receptacles are aligned. However the code adds an unspecced fini() method to the interface, which is not covered by this or any other requirement.

findings.description: Operates without root when /dev/vfio has appropriate user-level access
findings.notes: Permission checks use getuid/getegid for user-level verification

findings.description: Returns empty device list (not an error) when no devices are bound
findings.notes: enumerate_devices returns Ok(Vec) which may be empty

findings.description: Test example (main.rs binary) that instantiates component, wires logger, calls init(), queries ISPDKEnv, prints devices
findings.notes: Example exists as Cargo example (not main.rs binary target). Does not wire logger (consistent with FR-007 stating no logger receptacle exists, but contradicts this requirement's wording). Spec has internal inconsistency.

findings.description: Plain procedural component (not an actor); does not spawn threads or manage message queues
findings.notes: No actor infrastructure, no thread spawning, no message queues

findings.description: Properly clean up SPDK/DPDK resources when component is dropped
findings.notes: Drop impl calls do_fini() which calls spdk_env_fini() and clears singleton flag

findings.description: Checks hugepage availability and reports clear error if not configured
findings.notes: Checks both 2MB and 1GB hugepage pools; error includes allocation command hint

findings.description: Singleton semantics via process-global AtomicBool; second init() returns error; flag cleared on failure and on Drop
findings.notes: SPDK_ENV_ACTIVE uses compare_exchange; cleared in error path (line 33) and in do_fini() (line 199)

findings.description: Skip devices that cannot be probed (in use by another process), log warning for each, return only successfully probed devices
findings.notes: enumerate_devices() does not attempt to probe/claim devices (returns 1 from callback to avoid attaching). There is no mechanism to detect if a device is in use by another process. All visible devices are returned unconditionally.
Method defined in interface and implemented
Method defined in interface and implemented without cloning the device vector

findings.description: ISPDKEnv defined in BOTH spdk-env crate and shared interfaces crate; both must stay in sync
findings.notes: Definitions are currently in sync (same 5 methods) but no compile-time enforcement exists. A change in one will not break the other until a downstream consumer triggers a type mismatch.
